claim: A lamp that flickers out must be authored LIT with a positive shade amplitude, so it is drawn lit at rest and drops out; authored dark and flickering on, it reads in frames and at rest as a ring of light round a hole.
evidence: Phantom Terminus, 2026-11-24 (projects/blood-city/references/phantom-terminus-design.md); frames draw a wave at its lit instant (bloodmap.visual.shade_waves_lit)
use: Give a failing lamp its lit shade and a positive amplitude; let light_stage.switch_lamps move its neighbours with it.
